component.name: Klient
component.summary: Proton Mail with PGP, an AI assistant and an AI spam filter
Proton Mail s PGP, AI asistentem a AI spamfiltrem

description.p: A GNOME mail client that talks to Proton Mail directly over its API, without Proton Bridge.
E-mailový klient pro GNOME, který komunikuje s Proton Mail přímo přes jeho API, bez Proton Bridge.

ul.li: End-to-end encryption and native PGP for external recipients
End-to-end šifrování a nativní PGP pro externí příjemce
Conversations, safe HTML mail with remote content blocked, rich-text editor
Vlákna, bezpečné HTML zprávy s blokovaným vzdáleným obsahem, formátovaný editor
AI assistant and AI-driven spam filter (Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini) with blocklists updated every 12 hours
AI asistent a spamfiltr řízený AI (Claude, ChatGPT nebo Gemini) s blocklisty aktualizovanými každých 12 hodin
Encrypted offline cache, rules, undo send, one-click unsubscribe, print and .eml export
Šifrovaná offline cache, pravidla, zpoždění odeslání, odhlášení odběru, tisk a export .eml

description.p: Link to the source code on GitHub in About.
Help in the main menu (F1) opens the user documentation.
The spam-filter status shows the currently chosen AI model.
Monochrome panel icon with a red dot for new mail; user documentation.
Mistral AI (EU servers) as an AI provider; Ministral 3 available as a local model.
Gmail labels, archive and starred folder work like on the Gmail web.
Attachments at the top of messages; no more jumping back to the top while reading.
PGP encryption and signatures for Seznam, Gmail and IMAP accounts; used space for servers without a quota; consistent preferences.
Seznam, Gmail and IMAP accounts get conversation threads, snooze and scheduled sending.
Clearer Seznam login with two-factor authentication; full error messages.
Other mail services: Seznam.cz, Gmail (app password) and any IMAP/SMTP mailbox, with automatic setup and instant new-mail notification after the spam check.
Preparation for other mail services; service logos in the account switcher.
Author's website and contact in the About dialog.
New mail appears only after the spam filter has checked it, so spam never flashes up in the inbox.
The storage indicator matches Proton's web, refreshes regularly and turns orange or red when the mailbox is nearly full.
Faster local AI: summaries and label suggestions are remembered, summaries of new mail are prepared in advance on mains power, and the model stays loaded longer while charging.
Klient notices when it was updated while running in the background and offers a restart.

Local AI with Ollama: mail content never leaves the computer. Klient installs and automatically updates its own copy of Ollama and the used models, lets you compare models on your own mail, and has a local-only mode that blocks cloud AI.

Multiple accounts, background mode with a tray icon, scheduled send with a countdown, snooze, calendar invitations, vacation auto-reply, drag and drop, public key attachment and import, and new AI features: ask your mail, automatic labels and a morning overview.
Unsubscribe button fixes and automatic session recovery.
Clearer status of your own sent messages.
Fixes sending messages that contain only an attachment.
Proton contacts, address suggestions and a contacts window.
First test release.
